tariff_identity.null_result_reasoning: Johnstown, Milliken and Severance appear ZERO times in both extraction modes. What makes that evidence rather than a failed search: each missing town falls inside a printed alphabetical gap whose neighbours on BOTH sides extracted cleanly, so the extractor was working exactly where the town would have been.
tariff_identity.the_one_command_control: Search for a term you KNOW is present before trusting a term you believe is absent. Greeley IS in that tariff, so any pipeline that cannot find Greeley cannot establish that Johnstown is missing.
tariff_identity.do_not_cite_reason: It governs the superseded Second Revised Sheets. Cite No. 647 or cite nothing.
tariff_identity.grep_note: Grep as 'No. 647', not 'Advice Letter No. 647' — the phrase wraps a line break in the state documents and the full-phrase grep returns a false 0.

R4.program_aliases_reason: Bare 'Xcel' and 'Xcel Energy' are ONE program. Without this map a single sentence reading 'According to Xcel Energy, its ... Xcel ...' resolved to TWO distinct program names and satisfied R4's two-distinct-programs test by itself. Span-consuming matching stops one MENTION counting twice; only an alias map stops two mentions of the same utility counting as two programs.
